newsitem.title: INDIA: India TELCO shr up four pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India TELCO shr up four pct on results.

text.p: Shares of leading truckmaker Tata Engineering & Locomotive Company (TELCO) surged 15 rupees, or 3.8 percent to 408 on the Bombay bourse on Wednesday on hectic bids after the firm's results beat expectations, traders said.
TELCO said late on Tuesday its net profit jumped 44 percent to 7.62 billion rupees in the year ended March 31, from 5.3 billion in the previous year.
Automobile analysts -- who had pegged their 1996/97 net profit forecasts at around 7.2 billion rupees -- said a lower taxation rate and improved operating margins boosted profits.
TELCO's effective rate of tax was 24 percent in 1996/97, compared to 30 percent in the previous year.
But analysts said speculators would book profits in the stock at higher levels.
After the initial euphoria, investors would look towards an impending hike in diesel prices that was bound to bring the stock lower, analysts said.
